history_pairing.note: compares the log-reconstructed previous-frame table with the DLL matched flag; needs consecutive captured frames

depth_image_integrity.note: R32F device depth in [0,1] where a routed depth row covered the pixel, -1 elsewhere; nonfinite or out-of-range values fail

taa_image.note: sanity signal: the resolved FP16 image is finite; the fraction of pixels whose RGB moved away from the pre-resolve color by more than the threshold is reported, not judged

open: modelled, not measured, sharpen values: runD_0.75, runD_0.5, run10_0.5 (the RCAS reference validated at the measured value by section 1)
